newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian T-bills unchanged ahead of balance closing.
newsitem.headline: Russian T-bills unchanged ahead of balance closing.

text.p: Russian government securities were virtually unchanged on Monday on a lack of funds ahead of balance sheets closing at the end of half-year, dealers said.
*Average yield slipped to 19.38 pct from 19.46 pct on Friday
*Turnover fell to 2.98 trln rbls from 5.71 trln rbls
*Central bank did not intervene in the market
One dealer forecast a possible price fall as banks needed roubles to pay taxes.
"Prices have been rising for so long, that now everyone is thinking when to take a short position or to go cash," the dealer said.
